name: Smotritel
source:
Throughout all times, there have been those who protected the world from all threats. The world of Sovyonok is no exception. Just like everywhere else, it has its own problems and threats. Therefore, in this world, there is someone known as the "Watcher." Some also call him the "Dark Guardian" because he constantly wears clothes as black as night.

The protagonist, named Alexander, is given the honor of becoming one of the "Caretakers". And now he will have to preserve and protect this world by any means necessary. Or destroy it...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1558158531]Steam[/url]]

This is a reboot of the story from the DLC of [url=/v66334]Put Bezumtsa[/url].
